no_business_rules_reason: CBACT03C is a pure file-print utility: it opens the card cross-reference KSDS (XREFFILE) for sequential input, DISPLAYs every CARD-XREF-RECORD to SYSOUT, and closes the file. Its only conditional logic is file-status handling (end of file, abend code 999 on any I/O error).

observations.text: Each cross-reference record is displayed twice: once in 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT after a successful read and again in the main loop.

paragraphs.logic: Displays a start banner, opens XREFFILE, loops calling 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT until END-OF-FILE = 'Y' and displays CARD-XREF-RECORD after each successful read, then closes the file, displays an end banner and GOBACKs.
paragraphs.name: (PROCEDURE DIVISION entry)

paragraphs.logic: Reads the next XREFFILE record into CARD-XREF-RECORD and displays it on status '00'. Status '10' sets APPL-RESULT 16 and END-OF-FILE 'Y'; any other status displays 'ERROR READING XREFFILE', the file status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT

paragraphs.logic: Opens XREFFILE-FILE for input; a status other than '00' displays 'ERROR OPENING XREFFILE', the status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 0000-XREFFILE-OPEN

paragraphs.logic: Closes XREFFILE-FILE; a status other than '00' displays 'ERROR CLOSING XREFFILE', the status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE

paragraphs.logic: Displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM' and calls CEE3ABD with ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0.
paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM

paragraphs.logic: Formats IO-STATUS into the 4-digit IO-STATUS-04 (binary conversion of the second byte for non-numeric or '9x' statuses, otherwise zero-padded) and displays 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' with it.
paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

summary.text: CBACT03C is a batch COBOL utility that prints the card cross-reference file. It opens the indexed file XREFFILE (50-byte records keyed by card number, layout CVACT03Y linking card number, customer id and account id) for sequential input, reads every record into CARD-XREF-RECORD and DISPLAYs it to SYSOUT until end of file. It writes no files. Any open, read or close error displays the file status as NNNN and abends with code 999 via CEE3ABD.
